decision.question: Should we declare a 'sales sprint' for the next 2 weeks — zero infrastructure work, 100% revenue + funding outreach?
decision.recommendation: Yes. February is lost. The only way to hit even revised March targets is a hard pivot to outbound NOW. Every hour spent on Kira infra or Chimera this week is a hour not earning rent money.
evidence: 0 revenue generated in February despite 'First Revenue' being the month's theme
All OttoGen materials are ready (brand, DMs, content) — execution is the bottleneck, not preparation
IAM has 50 kindergarten leads ready to contact
ZenithCred has 20+ VCs mapped with zero outreach

options.label: 2-week sales sprint
options.description: Zero infra. Otto does OttoGen outreach (60%), IAM calls (20%), ZenithCred intros (20%). Kira handles follow-ups and scheduling.

options.label: Soft rebalance
options.description: Shift to 50/30/20 but keep some infra work. Lower risk of burnout but slower revenue.

options.label: Stay the course
options.description: Keep current allocation. Accept March will also be infrastructure-heavy.
